description.value: A cast and hammered tap with a stepped reducer, cut to fit the standard branch of settlement vent plumbing, with a flat tapping face on the body worn into a shallow dish. The plumbing on that world is the water supply and the telephone exchange at once, so the tap is a fitting and a speaking surface in the same object and is described locally in one word. It was collected in 2294 during the strain assay season, from a household that has not been contacted since. No drawing has been made and none will be made while the file is closed; the document filed with it is the consent form, which is why the two are kept together.
